stories.title: Outer Space debuts solar pavilion with hidden battery storage decking
stories.description: Outer Spaces launches with a novel approach to solar and battery energy storage for a home, using horizontal metal packs that are part of the decking.

stories.title: Mach launches Tier-1 autonomous solar mowing solution for utility-scale fleets
stories.description: Mach’s factory-integrated hardware and fleet orchestration platform target vegetation management bottlenecks for independent power producers.

stories.title: The agentic web is here
stories.description: In 2001, a decade after he invented the World Wide Web, Tim Berners-Lee articulated a new vision.

stories.title: Thousands of “ghost students” use AI to steal millions in student loans, DOJ says
stories.description: Applying for FAFSA may get messy as DOJ “ghost student” crackdown ramps up.

stories.title: Ford launches a ‘privacy promise’ and explains how and why it uses customer data
stories.description: Ford said it's making an "explicit commitment" to its customers that "their vehicle data is safe" with the company.

stories.title: Here’s what ‘renoa’ — the first new fiber in 25 years — feels like
stories.description: Startup Everbloom's new material, renoa, is the first new fiber in 25 years, and it feels very familiar.

stories.title: Supermarket freezers in Belgium, Sweden and Luxembourg hit by suspected cyber-attack
stories.description: Stores in Sweden say temperatures for its freezers were raised to 50 C (122F).

stories.title: Ryanair says it may freeze workers' pay and raise airfares
stories.description: The airline says fuel prices may rise by €2bn in 2028 unless there is an end to the US-Israel war with Iran.

stories.title: Physicists created a tiny universe and watched time emerge without a clock
stories.description: Scientists have created a miniature universe in the laboratory that could help answer one of the biggest mysteries in physics: What is time, and where does it come from? Using 24,000 ultracold atoms, a University of Birmingham researcher built an isolated quantum system that repeatedly expands and contracts, mimicking the Big Bang and a possible Big Crunch.

stories.title: Scientists confirm global warming is accelerating faster than ever recorded
stories.description: Earth is warming faster than ever recorded, with scientists detecting a major acceleration in global temperatures since around 2015. A new study reveals that the warming rate has surged to approximately 0.35°C per decade, nearly double the average pace observed from 1970 to 2015.

stories.title: Japan proposes 50-metric-ton trigger for solar panel recycling plans
stories.description: A Japanese government study group is weighing rules that would bring almost all conventional solar panels under a new recycling law, while leaving perovskite and flexible modules out for now.

stories.title: Common pesticide linked to 2.5 times the risk of Parkinson’s disease
stories.description: A UCLA study found that long-term exposure to a common pesticide was linked to more than 2.5 times the risk of Parkinson's disease. Scientists also uncovered how the chemical damages brain cells and identified a promising way to protect them.
